segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Hello Rohini, good afternoon. Can you hear us properly?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes, yes, I can hear. Sorry, I am at the workshop so there may be some noise from the looms.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: No problem ma'am. This week I finished the product buttons in indigo and the category pages for all six categories. Saree photos are also uploaded now.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: I saw the sarees. They look lovely. The Kota doria ones are a bit dark though, maybe the photo, not your fault.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: From my side, coupons are working with your rule, ten percent for orders of five thousand or more, valid one month. Shipping charge of ninety-nine below two thousand five hundred is also added.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Good. And that problem I told you, payment going but order not coming? Is it solved?

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: I could repeat it, ma'am. It happens when the customer pays but does not reach our thank-you page, like when the network drops or the tab is closed. I am working on a fix with Sunita ma'am. It is not finished yet.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Okay. Please finish that before launch. That one really scares me.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Now, I showed the site to my sister-in-law and two customers. One thing all of them said: the checkout does not feel trustworthy. Can you make the checkout feel more trustworthy?

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Okay ma'am. Did they say which part they did not trust?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Not exactly. My sister-in-law said she would be scared to put her card there. One customer said it looks different from the rest of the site. I don't know, it should just feel safe. Like the big websites.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: The payment page itself is from Stripe, so the look changes there a little.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: I don't know what that means for the customer. They just see our shop and then suddenly something else. You tell me what can be done.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: We will come back with some options for that. Was there anything else from their feedback?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: No, the rest they liked. But from my side there is one more thing. When I log in as admin, I want to see how the business is doing at a glance.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: There is the analytics tab now, ma'am. It shows total users, products, total sales and revenue, and a chart of the last seven days.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes I saw that. It is nice, but I open it and I still don't know if we are doing well or not. At a glance, you know? I should look for five seconds and know.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Okay...

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Komal also says she needs to know what to pack every morning. Maybe that is the same thing, maybe not. You decide.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Ananya, Rukhsar, do you have any questions for Rohini on these two points before we close?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes, ask me now, because next week I am in Delhi for an exhibition from Tuesday and I will be hard to reach.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Also just reminding, I want to go live by 10th October, before the Diwali rush. That date cannot move.
